_comment: Phase F pure-data exercise registry. See docs/08_exercise_config.md for the full schema, evidence for `type`, and the fill-in-the-blanks threshold table for the owner. Every `value: null` field below is an unfilled clinical placeholder — do NOT treat null as 0 or skip it in a real comparison.

enter_angle._TODO: knee angle (hip-knee-ankle) that starts a rep as the heel slides toward the buttocks (knee flexing, angle decreasing)

exit_angle._TODO: knee angle that completes a rep as the heel slides back out (knee extending, angle increasing)

depth_target._TODO: minimum flexion (lowest knee angle) required during the slide-in phase for the rep to count; 0 disables the check

heel_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = heel rising off the support surface
heel_lifting_max_y_rise._TODO: max allowed rise in left/right_heel_rel_y from the resting-frame baseline before flagging heel_lifting

hip_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = pelvis rising off the support surface
hip_lifting_max_y_rise._TODO: max allowed rise in pelvis_center_y from the resting-frame baseline before flagging hip_lifting

enter_angle._TODO: knee angle that starts a rep as the squat descends

exit_angle._TODO: knee angle that completes a rep as the squat returns to standing

depth_target._TODO: minimum knee flexion (lowest angle) required during the squat for the rep to count; 0 disables the check

heel_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = heel rising off the floor
heel_lifting_max_y_rise._TODO: max allowed rise in left/right_heel_rel_y from standing baseline before flagging heel_lifting

knee_varus_max_angle_deg.sign_convention: TBD by owner — angle of medial knee deviation from the hip-ankle line, FRONT view
knee_varus_max_angle_deg._TODO: max allowed inward (varus) knee deviation before flagging knee_varus; exact formula/landmarks TBD by owner

knee_past_toes_max_margin._TODO: max allowed forward displacement of knee_rel_x past foot_index_rel_x before flagging knee_past_toes

ankles_min_width_ratio.sign_convention: below threshold = ankles too close together
ankles_min_width_ratio._TODO: minimum ankle_width_3d:shoulder_width_3d ratio before flagging ankles_close_together

back_slouching_min_trunk_angle_deg._TODO: minimum trunk angle before flagging back_slouching

enter_angle._TODO: knee angle that starts a rep as the seated leg begins extending

exit_angle._TODO: knee angle that completes a rep as the leg returns to the flexed start position

depth_target._TODO: minimum extension (highest knee angle) required during the rep for it to count; 0 disables the check

hip_lifting_max_y_rise.unit: normalized y (pelvis_center_y vs the extractor's own whole-file 'baseline' column)
hip_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = pelvis rising off the seat
hip_lifting_max_y_rise._TODO: max allowed rise of pelvis_center_y above the clip's 'baseline' column before flagging hip_lifting

back_slouching_min_trunk_angle_deg._TODO: minimum trunk angle before flagging back_slouching

back_rocking_max_score.unit: same units as the extractor's own whole-file 'rocking_score' column (std-dev of head x-position)

enter_angle._TODO: hip angle (shoulder-hip-knee) that starts a rep as the straight leg lifts off the surface

exit_angle._TODO: hip angle that completes a rep as the leg returns to the surface

depth_target._TODO: hip angle target at peak raise for the rep to count as a full raise; 0 disables the check. Legacy label-editor reference constant HIP_MAX_DEG=46 (as raise-angle = 180-hip_angle) exists in test/code/label-editor/slr_label_editor.py but is a LABELING threshold, not confirmed as the live clinical target — do not copy without owner sign-off

hip_lifting_max_raise_angle_deg.unit: deg, raise angle = 180 - hip_angle_2d at peak-raise frame
hip_lifting_max_raise_angle_deg.sign_convention: above threshold = excessive hip flexion / compensation, labeled hip_lifting in this dataset
hip_lifting_max_raise_angle_deg._TODO: max allowed peak raise angle before flagging hip_lifting (dataset's label-editor used 46 deg for LABELING only — needs independent clinical confirmation)

knee_flexion_high_min_angle_deg.sign_convention: below threshold = knee bending too much during the raise (should stay near full extension)
knee_flexion_high_min_angle_deg._TODO: minimum knee angle (extension) required through the raise before flagging knee_flexion_high; docstring suggests a ~170-180 deg tolerance band but exact value TBD by owner

head_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = head rising off the surface
head_lifting_max_y_rise._TODO: max allowed rise in nose_rel_y from the resting-frame baseline before flagging head_lifting

enter_angle._TODO: knee angle that starts a rep as the leg begins extending toward terminal extension

exit_angle._TODO: knee angle that completes a rep as the leg returns from terminal extension

depth_target._TODO: minimum terminal-extension angle (highest knee angle, near 180) required during the rep for it to count; 0 disables the check

hip_lifting_max_y_rise.unit: normalized y (pelvis_center_y vs the extractor's own whole-file 'avg_pelvis_center_y' column)
hip_lifting_max_y_rise.sign_convention: positive = pelvis rising off the support surface
hip_lifting_max_y_rise._TODO: max allowed rise of pelvis_center_y above the clip's 'avg_pelvis_center_y' column before flagging hip_lifting

exercises.name: squat
exercises._note: Restored from the legacy physio project per owner instruction and MASTER_BUILD_PLAN_v3 §F1/§G2. Unlike the five ML-dataset exercises, every value here is REAL — transcribed from backend/_old_physio_reference/config.py, documented in docs/03_legacy.md D5. Not a placeholder.

knee_cave_min_width_ratio.alert: Knees caving in — push knees out

torso_lean_max_deg.signal: torso lean from vertical (shoulder-hip vs vertical)
torso_lean_max_deg.alert: Leaning too far forward — chest up

knee_past_toes_max_x_ratio.alert: Knee past toes — sit back more

butt_wink_min_hip_angle_deg.alert: Lower back rounding — brace your core

butt_wink_max_knee_angle_deg.signal: knee angle gate — butt wink only checked when knee is at least this bent

neck_min_angle_deg.alert: Neck not neutral — look straight ahead

depth_insufficient_alert.signal: raised when a rep never reached depth_target
